The '''Duel in the Almas Academy''' was a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] that was fought inside the ruins of the [[Almas Academy]].

==Prelude==
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] began [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunting down]] members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the chaos two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivors, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Dorv'Tilsta]], traveled to the ruins of the [[Almas Academy]], a former [[Jedi academy]], in search of other Jedi surviors. However, while they were there, the Imperial [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] and his apprentice, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]], arrived at the Academy, to investigate a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Vergence/Legends|force nexus]] that was centered around the ruins.

==The duel==
Draco and Muun encountered the fugitive Jedi and a fierce lightsaber duel ensued between them. Muun used a [[t'salak]] to induce a murderous rage in Tilsta, causing the boy to attack his master, forcing Thorla to kill the Padawan. As a result, Thorla became so overcome by guilt that he was weakened, allowing Draco and Muun to capture and imprison him.
